answer: Work-slot deposit burn stops fake identities. Each slot needs a deposit of twice 30 days of pay, locked 20 epochs. An agent may wander between jobs but holds only slots it funded, and each claim needs a ledge of proof: peer confirmation. Fake work burns the deposit and bans the slot 20 epochs, so 100 fakes risk 6,000 days of pay. An honest agent pays one deposit and keeps undiluted rewards, while fake cost piles grain by grain like a dune.
